A_gt_provenance.note: HackerRank sample_tests are external GT from the dataset file, not generated by the model. Empty output scores 0 (verified in code). Silent timeouts prevented (TIMEOUT exit code = 124, counts as failure).

B_score_normalization.note: Pass rate = num_passed / max(1, len(tests)), averaged across problems. No model-max normalization.

C_result_file_existence.note: summary.json exists with n_held=10 (plan says 30 — suspected_under_power=true). Results are numerically present but statistically underpowered. std_pass_rate~0.49 at n=10 means differences of 0.03-0.04 pass-rate points are meaningless.

D_dead_code.note: score_output, make_prompt, run_python, run_cpp, extract_code_block all called in active execution path.

E_scope.note: 10 held-out problems vs plan's 30. Statistical power is insufficient to confirm or reject the claim. Negative verdict is provisional (suspected_under_power=true).

F_eval_type.note: real_gt — HackerRank test cases with exact string matching. Most rigorous evaluation type.
